prompt: Modern cities should be designed to encourage people to spend time together in shared public spaces rather than primarily focusing on private housing and commercial buildings. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
It is often argued that modern cities should be designed to encourage people to spend more time together in shared public spaces rather than focusing mainly on private housing and commercial buildings. However, I personally agree with this view because public spaces can strengthen community relationships and improve people's quality of life.

The primary reason why I agree with this view is that shared public spaces can strengthen community relationships. This is mainly because people can come together and interact with others in these places. In other words, public spaces provide opportunities for social interaction and cooperation among residents. For example, neighbours may meet in a public park and take part in community activities together. As a result, people can develop stronger relationships and a greater sense of community. Therefore, I believe that cities should provide more shared public spaces.

Furthermore, another important reason why I agree with this view is that public spaces can improve people's quality of life by providing opportunities for leisure and recreation. This is because people need time for relaxation and recreational activities after work or study. For instance, residents can visit parks and other shared areas to spend their free time with family or friends. Consequently, people can enjoy more leisure activities and have greater overall life satisfaction. Therefore, I strongly agree with this view.

In conclusion, I firmly agree with the view that modern cities should encourage people to spend time together in shared public spaces. This is mainly because public spaces can strengthen community relationships and improve people's quality of life.
